objective: Post-train a single-pass recurrent online-memory model whose own RWKV state causally selects chunk-aligned projected values and improves a fresh three-task benchmark without task-specific routers or decoding rules.

architecture.projected_values: one learned projected value per fixed RWKV chunk
architecture.routing: learned recurrent query/state compatibility selects the projected-value slot

prompt_robustness.donor_prompt_variant: same as target to prevent format leakage

training.hardware: exactly four distinct NVIDIA A100 GPUs

causal_controls.correct_recurrent_state: target recurrent state with target projected carrier
causal_controls.zero_recurrent_state: all recurrent tensors zero with target projected carrier fixed
causal_controls.matched_donor_recurrent_state: different-answer same-task donor recurrent tensors with target projected carrier fixed
causal_controls.slot_shuffled_recurrent_state: target recurrent matrix slots cyclically shifted within every layer with target projected carrier fixed
causal_controls.layer_permuted_recurrent_state: all recurrent tensors cyclically shifted across layers with target projected carrier fixed
causal_controls.projected_carrier_audit: same tensor references during training and byte-identical hashes during evaluation

final_gate.split: fresh committed final rows opened only after development pass
final_gate.generation: single-pass greedy batch-one with one write then one read
final_gate.success_rule: candidate is at least the stronger of base and projected-slot baseline on every task, is strictly better than both on at least one task, and correct recurrent state beats every causal control with fixed projected carriers

stopping_rule.preflight_failure: archive signed failure and do not run full training
stopping_rule.development_failure: archive signed failure and keep final rows unopened
stopping_rule.final_failure: archive signed failure and do not claim model improvement
stopping_rule.final_pass: archive model, hashes, raw predictions, metrics, causal controls, and signed pass receipt
